environment.description: Bare-metal deployment on Ubuntu 22.04 with Go 1.21 binary running directly. WebSocket endpoint exposed on port 8080 via public IP. No reverse proxy, no WAF, no additional middleware. Static assets served from local ./static directory. Clients connect directly to ws://<host>:8080/ws. The ws-client.js file is served with correct SRI hash matching the deployed version.

config.sri_enforcement: browser-side only, no CSP header enforcing SRI requirement
